Menyimpan payment lalu langsung memanggi: Saving a payment and immediately calling a broker gives the two systems different boundaries. The payment can commit while the process dies before publishing, or publishing can happen while the database transaction rolls back. Both orders create a gap: a business fact without a message, or a message without a committed business fact. A transactional outbox moves side-effect intent into a database table written in the same transaction as the payment.
Outbox bukan broker dan bukan bukti pesa: An outbox is not a broker and is not proof that a message was sent. A committed outbox row is work for a worker to discover. This design provides a reconcilable source of work; it does not turn the network, broker, and database into one global transaction.

Therefore INSERT ... RETURNING can pass newly written rows to another query, or the application can split INSERT and SELECT into separate statements in a transaction. Do not rely on an outer SELECT to reread an INSERT target from the same data-modifying CTE.
